coverImageAlt: Blank paper ribbon passing through a cyan glass sieve and emerging as an orange-edged arrow.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: an unrefined blank paper ribbon passes through a critical optical sieve and emerges as a focused, persuasive arrow-shaped fold aimed clearly forward
Scene/backdrop: warm paper studio with a deep navy gradient wall and generous breathing room
Subject: one continuous blank ribbon entering a faceted cyan lens-and-sieve sculpture, shedding fuzzy excess fibers, and exiting as a crisp folded form with one sparing orange edge
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration with folded paper, optical glass, and dimensional craft detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; clean left-to-right transformation with the lens as dominant focal object; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: discerning, clear, persuasive, quietly energetic
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Materials/textures: blank deckled paper, translucent glass, soft paper fibers, matte painted base
Constraints: paper entirely blank with no writing or marks; no rating scales or score symbols; original composition; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, paw logos, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling
Avoid: megaphones, bullseyes, social-media icons, advertisements, screens, dashboards, generic documents, clutter
